final: WITH counts AS (SELECT m.member_id, m.position, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count FROM attendance AS a JOIN member AS m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position), shares AS (SELECT member_id, position, attendance_count, attendance_count * 1.0 / SUM(attendance_count) OVER () AS share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY attendance_count DESC) AS share_rank FROM counts) SELECT member_id, position, attendance_count, share FROM shares WHERE share_rank <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC, member_id
